tools.name: create_order
tools.description:
Create an order from a quote. Returns the order id plus what the user must sign: a
deposit address / PSBT for onramps, or the EVM or Tron transaction otherwise.

tools.name: get_max_spendable
tools.description: Maximum BTC (sats) an address can send to an onramp after estimated network fees.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Get an order's status and details.

tools.name: get_orders
tools.description: List orders for one or more user addresses, paginated.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description:
Get a quote for a swap (onramp quotes are signed by the API). Pass the returned object
unchanged to `create_order`.

tools.name: get_routes
tools.description: List supported swap routes (source/destination chain and token pairs).

tools.name: quote_and_create
tools.description:
Get a quote and create an order from it in one call, returning both as `quote` and
`order`. Takes the `get_quote` arguments, with `refund_address` required. Creating an
order screens its addresses, so use this only once the user wants to swap, and `get_quote`
to check a price.

tools.name: register_tx
tools.description:
Broadcast an already-signed onramp Bitcoin transaction through the gateway. Optional:
deposits are detected on-chain without it. The broadcast cannot be undone.

tools.name: wait_for_order
tools.description:
Wait for an order's status to leave `inProgress`, reading it every 15 seconds for up to
about 45. Returns the order as `get_order` does, as soon as its status changes or once
the wait is over; call again while it is still `inProgress`. Under heavy load it may
